svg.aria-label: Animation: two logs are dragged from a woodpile onto a fire, each adding 15 minutes to a focus timer as the flames grow; then time fast-forwards and at every 15-minute mark a log burns down and the fire gets smaller
svg.title: two logs are dragged from a woodpile onto a fire, each adding 15 minutes to a focus timer as the flames grow; then time fast-forwards and at every 15-minute mark a log burns down and the fire gets smaller
svg.text: DRAG A LOG ONTO THE FIRE · +15 MIN EACH
